notes.title: 14/03/2023 Game Update (v-1.1.26)
notes.notes:
[i]Hello everyone, Fallen Flag Studio here! We hope everyone is doing great; we're excited to share with y'all the latest Eldest Souls balance changes!

Many of these changes have been inspired by our Community, and are aimed at spicing up a little some Shards while also giving a much needed balance pass to some of the bosses to finesse the experience for both old and new players![/i]

[h2][b]Balance[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Shards[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Lightbringer (Azikel Shard Active) -[/b]
[list]
[*]Damage per tick: 7 -> 10;
[*]Speed increase buff: 25% -> 35%;
[/list]
[*][b]Lunar Inspiration (Aryana Shard Active) -[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased damage of all attacks by 25%;
[/list]
[*][b]United's Blessing (Eos Shard Active) -[/b]
[list]
[*]Fire attack damage: 75 -> 90;
[/list]
[*][b]Empire's Wrath (Depths of the Forgotten Shard Active) -[/b]
[list]
[*]Max damage: 200 -> 250;
[/list]
[/list]

[h3][b]Infusions[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Crimson Counter (Deer God + Counter) -[/b]
[list]
[*]Self-damage taken on activation: 45% HP -> 35% HP;
[/list]
[/list]

[h3][b]Bosses[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Eos, God of Unity  -[/b]
[list]
[*]Fire Font attack size increased by 33%;
[/list]
[*][b]Hyem of the Frigid Waste  -[/b]
[list]
[*]Icicle size increased by 25%;
[*]Max number of icicles and runes increased by 35%;
[/list]
[*][b]Deer God  -[/b]
[list]
[*]Blood Lilies now require 20% more blood spilled to grow;
[/list]
[*][b]Warden of Purity  -[/b]
[list]
[*]The Warden's hands now take 25% increased damage;
[/list]
[*][b]Aryana, First of the Moon  -[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased HP by 15%;
[/list]
[*][b]Drakmur, the Nightmare  -[/b]
[list]
[*]Drakmur melee attacks now created a random number of darkness orbs.
[/list]
[*][b]Zylad, Lord of Steel  -[/b]
[list]
[*]Dragonslayer Sword (Floating sword) now has a better hit check to avoid players being sometimes dragged by the attack while dodging.
[/list]
[*][b]The Rejected Daughter  -[/b]
[list]
[*]Cobwebs spawn time increased by 15%.
[/list]
[*][b]The Rotting Crown -[/b]
[list]
[*]Lightening Orbs no longer stun players again if the player is already stunned.
[/list]
[*][b]Eksyll, Princeps  -[/b]
[list]
[*]Reduced cool-down time of special attacks by 25%
[*]Reduced cool-down of falling rocks during final phase by 25%.
[/list]
[*][b]Abyssal Guardian (NG+ Guardian) -[/b]
[list]
[*]Corruption zones size reduced by 20%
[*]Corruption zones now spawn 35% less often.
[/list]

[/list]

[i]Us at Fallen Flag want to thank all the players for the continuous and amazing support that Eldest Souls has received since launch. Please keep sharing your feedback with us through the [url=https://discord.gg/ZfBawTQ]Community Discord[/url][/i], and keep an eye on our socials for more Eldest Souls and of course future projects!

PS: Here's some Steam keys to share with your friends (if you're fast enough!)
[list]
[*]LNKGL-GKERK-M5C@TN
[*]VX@F3B-XXGHT-9HNDM
[*]VMHH7-Q0@EZJ-NL9K7
[/list]
PPS: we've added some @ symbols in the codes to counter those pesky bots, make sure to remove any @ symbol before claiming your key!

notes.title: 22/12/2021 Game Update (v 1.0.479)
notes.notes:
[i]Hello everyone! This update includes some long awaited fixes and some balance tweaks aimed at improving certain shards and some underused Talents. We at Fallen Flag would also like to use this occasion to wish all our players happy holidays, and to ask for you to keep an eye on Eldest Souls in the new year, as bigger and better things are yet to come! ːsteamthisː[/i]

[h2][b]Balance[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Fighting Styles - Counter[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Stand Your Ground -[/b] 
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause Stand Your Ground additional counter bar on hit to not work as intended. 
[*]Increased counter bar generation on guard hit while on Stand Your Ground 
from 3% → 20%.[/*]
[/list]
[/list]

[h3][b]Fighting Styles - Berserker Slash[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Tectonic Shock -[/b] 
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that could prevent Tectonic Shock to deal the appropriate damage when player had 4 stacks of Berserk buff.
[*]Tectonic Shock damage changed from 5 → 40 to 20 → 60.[/*]
[/list]
[/list]

[h3][b]Fighting Styles - Windslide[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Flurry - [/b] 
[list]
[*]Number of cuts increased 5 → 6
[/list]
[*][b]Wind Aura - [/b] 
[list]
[*]Damage while at max stacks increased 20 → 22
[*]Thick time while at max stacks adjusted 1.4s → 1.2s
[/list]
[/list]

[h3][b]Shard - Corrupted Grasp (Guardian Active Shard)[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause Grapple Hook to feel inconsistent / buggy when too close to a boss or walls. 
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause Grapple Hook to sometimes not deal damage or grant player Bloodthirst.
[*]Improved responsiveness and feel of grappling to enemies.
[/list]

[h3][b]Shard - Singularity Orb (Drakmur Active Shard) [/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Changed how force is applied to the moving Orb. The movement speed is now incremental, should make the skill easier to use and more predictable.  
[*]Cooldown changed from 5s → 3s.
[/list]

[h3][b]Shard - Winter Fangs (Hyem Active Shard) [/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Increased first hit damage from 10 → 25 and second hit damage from 100 → 125.
[*]Cooldown changed from 8s → 6.5s
[/list]


[i]That about sums it up! And, in the spirits of the holidays, we'd like to thank our community again with a few game codes for Eldest Souls. If you have any friend who didn't play the game yet... ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: 03/09/2021 Game Update (v 1.0.472)
notes.notes:
[i]Hello everyone! This update includes the new Speed Run Mode containing some community-requested features, a bunch of bug-fixes and a small balance pass. We're committed to continue making the game better, so please continue sharing your feedback with us! [/i]

[h2][b]Balance[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Boss - Eksyll[/b][/h3]
[*]Fixed an issue that caused Eksyll to sometimes delay his special attacks for too long. (Special attacks: Tile attacks during Phase 1, Boss shards attacks during phase 2)[/*]
[*]Fixed an issue that caused Eksyll to begin Phase 03 with ~20% less HP than intended[/*]
[*]Fixed an issue that caused Eksyll's Phase 03 falling rocks to begin too early.[/*]
[h3][b]Fighting Styles - Berserk Slash[/b][/h3]
[*]Chain Fracture [b]-[/b] Damage per Berserker stack = 20 → 7[/*]
[h3][b]Fighting Styles - Counter[/b][/h3]
[*][b]Shoulder Bash -[/b] Counter bar generated = 10% → 25%[/*]
[*][b]Heavy Build -[/b] Damage and Counter bar % increase = 33% → 45%[/*]
[*][b]Protector's Reach -[/b] Travel distance and speed increase = 50% → 75%[/*]
[h3][b]Fighting Styles - Windslide[/b][/h3]
[*][b]Flurry -[/b] Number of Flurry's Cuts = 4 → 5 Damage per Flurry's Cut = 8 → 9 Flurry speed and reach = 100% → 120%.[/*]
[*][b]Heavy thrusts -[/b] Bonus damage = 75% → 100%[/*]

[i][b]Dev note:[/b] Bumping up a few underused talents, while nerfing a Berserk talent that we missed on patch .468[/i]


[h3][b]Shards - Wild Hunt[/b][/h3]
[*][b]Crimson Counter -[/b] Crimson Counter minimum reactivation delay = 0s → 0.15s;[/*]
[*][b]Crimson Slide -[/b] Crimson Slide minimum reactivation delay = 0s → 0.15s[/*]

[i][b]Dev note:[/b] We really don't want speed-runners to hurt their hands by spamming a button as fast as possible! Hopefully this is a good change, send feedback please![/i]


[h3][b]Shards - Corrupted Grasp[/b][/h3]
[*][b]Active -[/b] Damage on Hit = 25 → 20; Healing on hit = 15 → 10;[/*]
[h3][b]Shards - Winter Fangs[/b][/h3]
[*][b]Active -[/b] Cooldown = 12s → 8s[/*]

[i][b]Dev note:[/b] Grapple is fun but a bit too strong! we won't touch the Cooldown, but tuned other stats a bit down. We also want to make other active shards a bit stronger, will work towards that in the future.[/i]

[h2][b]Fixes and Updates[/b][/h2]

[*]Added [b]Speed Run Mode:[/b] Can be activated in settings and enables:[/*]
[*]Run timer on top right corner[/*]
[*]No death icon on top right corner[/*]
[*]No damage icon on top right corner[/*]
[*]Game version on bottom right corner[/*]
[*]Fixed an issue causing NG+ modifiers (damage taken increase, healing reduced ) to not apply properly in Arena Mode+ fights.[/*]
[*]Added a "Retry" button to quickly start a fight again after an Arena encounter is defeated.[/*]
[*]Attempting to fix an issue where quitting the game at a specific time while Eksyll is defeated would 
    cause the game to incorrectly not trigger the NG+ cycle.[/*]
[*]Fixed an issue that caused Counter Bar generation to be calculated incorrectly at times.[/*]
[*]Fixed an issue causing the NG+ message at the end of a Game Cycle to show the wrong number of 
    HP % bonus on bosses (was too high). The value is a rough approximation as different bosses gain different %HP bonuses.[/*]
[*]Fixed an issue with Chain Fracture localization to better describe it's effect. 
    " ... Upon Furious expiration, cause..." → "... When Furuious is refreshed or expires, cause..."[/*]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1108590/Eldest_Souls/

notes.title: 10/08/2021 Game Update (v 1.0.468)
notes.notes:
[h3][i]Hello y'all! just wanted to give a quick big "thank you" from us Devs for all the players who took the time to play the game, review it, or share their feedback with us over on the Steam Community or [url=https://discord.gg/Z9ruKVTPFW]Discord[/url].
It's been a great experience, and we're working hard on improving the game, implementing QoL changes and fixing bugs as quickly as we can. 

That being said, let's move on to the patch notes![/i][/h3]

[h1]--- 1.0.468 Update ---
[/h1]


[b][h2]Balance ---[/h2]
[/b]
[h3]Boss - Aryana[/h3]
[list][*]Time required for Aryana to switch phases (and destroy the arena) reduced by ~20%[/*][/list]

[b][h3]Fighting Styles - Berserker Slash[/h3]
[/b][list][*][b]Fury Fragments - [/b]
Damage  % increase per Furious stack = 15% → 12%[/*][/list][list][*][b]Deepened Fury - [/b]
Fury Fang increase when collecting a fragment = 25% → 20%[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chain Reaction - [/b]
damage = 30 → 15[/*][/list][list][*][b]Reckless Fragmentation - [/b]
Damage taken & dealt bonus =  5% → 3%[/*][/list][list][*][b]Aftershock - [/b]
Damage % increase = 25% → 30%[/*][/list]
[i][b]Dev note: [/b]
we don't want to kill the "crazy damage zerk / fury fragment builds" , but hopefully reducing a little bit of its numbers will open up the other branch and fighting styles a bit more.[/i]


[h3][b]Fighting Styles - Counter
[/b][/h3][list][*][b]Radiant Arsenal -[/b]
Shield granted = 3 → 2[/*][/list][list][*][b]Aegis of Radiance -[/b]
Shield granted = 3 → 2[/*][/list][list][*][b]Warding Arsenal -[/b]
Damage taken reduction = 20% → 15%[/*][/list][list][*][b]Warding Blades -[/b]
damage = 40 → 45[/*][/list][list][*][b]Fatal Blade -[/b]
damage = 50 → 60
Shield effect - 10 → 5
[/*][/list][list][*][b]Shoulder Bash -[/b]
damage = 30 → 45[/*][/list][list][*][b]Stand your Ground -[/b]
Counter Damage bonus = 60% → 70%[/*][/list]
[i][b]Dev note:[/b]
We think counter tree provides an interesting play-style, but it turned out that full builds can gain huge amounts of shield sustain.
We're toning shields down a bit, while increasing the overall damage to make the branch as a whole (hopefully) scale better into the late-game / ng+ builds.[/i]


[b][h3]Fighting Styles - Windslide
[/h3][/b][list][*][b]Windslide -[/b]
Number of Windslide slashes (with full bar) = 5 → 6
Windslide slashes damage (with full bar) = 10 → 12
[/*][/list][list][*][b]Leafstorm -[/b]
base damage of Stormleaf (scales with charge attack amount) = 10 → 20[/*][/list][list][*] [b]Storm's Eye[/b] - 
Storm's Eye damage = 44 → 60
[/list]
[i][b]Dev note:
[/b][/i][i]For the unfortunate few of you who played our Beta Steam Demos, you might or might not remember Windslide being a DPS monster, making the other branches look quite underwhelming.
It seems like our previous adjustments have pushed Windslide a bit too low for what we'd like to see, so we're carefully reverting some of the beta nerfs.
[/i]


[b][h2]Fixes and QoL ---[/h2]
[/b][list][*]Fixed a Camera issue that could prevent proper tracking of the middle-point between the Player and the Boss.[/*][/list][list][*]Updated/fixed resolution to include all solutions and not only matching to Aspect Ratio.[/*][/list][list][*]Fixed stats rounding in main menu and arena mode stats.[/*][/list][list][*]Fixed player occasionally dying when travelling to the Nightmare while dashing.[/*][/list][list][*]Fixed instance where player could get stuck on frozen statues in the spire.[/*][/list][list][*]Fixed instance where player could get stuck on benches at the entrance of the Sanctuary.[/*][/list][list][*]Fixed instance where shield could effect appear in the player HUD even when HUD is off.[/*][/list][list][*]Fixed instance where player could die to Drakmur Mirrors during Eksyll transition phase (added immunity to player).[/*][/list][list][*]Fixed instance where Wild Hunt active shard buff could reset improperly at times.[/*][/list][list][*]Fixed instance where Hyem HUD frozen particle could remain incorrectly on player stamina bar.[/*][/list][list][*]Fixed instance where Hyem Ice Waves particles might not play particles properly after some time.[/*][/list][list][*]Updated Singularity Orb infusion copies to avoid incorrect collision with bosses.[/*][/list][list][*]Added Enrage particles for Warden of Purity.[/*][/list][list][*]Updated warning particle for various Warden of Purity Attacks[/*][/list][list][*]Replaced the Warden of Purity's "Expanding ring" that followed a Fist Attack during enrage with a different, circle-shaped AoE. This was done due to the expanding ring hitbox & visual not being clear enough.[/*][/list][list][*]Updated Deer God Lilies visuals to make mechanics more clear.[/*][/list][list][*]Updated spawn position of Eksyll's Iron Crusher, now beginning closer to the boss.[/*][/list][list][*]Added more consistent pushback and small immunity frame when player kills one of the EOS orbs.[/*][/list][list][*]Disabled EOS parallax effect in Arena due to issues, working on more permanent solution.[/*][/list][list][*]Reduced Hyem's Enrage Animation camera zoom to keep player in the shot.[/*][/list]


Final Dev note:
Thanks for reading through our notes, and fear not, there's more to come! As always, please share your feedback on our Steam Community or [url=https://discord.gg/Z9ruKVTPFW]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Day One Patch - Out Now!
notes.notes:
First off, allow us to say a huge thank you to each and every one of you for an amazing launch! We’re overwhelmed by the hugely positive response to our soulslike boss-rush, [i]Eldest Souls[/i]. 

But let’s face it. Slaying the Old Gods is tough enough already, so any tweaks and improvements (as minor as they might be), are an absolute blessing from the… um… well probably not the Gods, actually. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36102687/6218ad285052b8829b71c700454d76752c94721b.png[/img]

So to that effect, please find below a list of the Patch 1.01 fixes: 

- Fixed issue where defeating Guardian twice in arena mode blocked other bosses from NG+2
- Made it more obvious when the Warden is taking damage
- Drakmur can no longer teleport out of arena
- Player can no longer clip through objects in Concord Sanctuary
- Minor shard HP balance tweaks
- Minor UI and VFX bug fixes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36102687/30d666f6f9391feb1603cba1604dee293ba870be.png[/img]

As for those of you yet to unsheath your obsydian greatsword, good news - you can currently get [b]15% off [i]Eldest Souls[/i] for a limited time only![/b] And if you need that extra little bit of convincing, well, how about the fact we currently have a [b]89% positive rating[/b] on steam. Still not enough? Then check out what some of the press have had to say about our medieval, pixel-art adventure so far… 

[i]"It’s like the best parts of a Dark Souls game distilled into one pint-sized, pixelated package."[/i]
~ [b]HeyPoorPlayer, 9/10[/b]

[I]"Call me a masochist, because I loved every minute of it." [/i]
~ [b]Tom’s Guide, 9/10[/b]

[i]"Eldest Souls offers so much replayability, in so many ways." [/i]
~ [b]GameTyrant, 9/10[/b]

[i]"a wonderful experience overall" [/i]
~ [b]ScreenRant, 4/5[/b]

[i]"Eldest Souls will punish you with its difficulty, but you're going to love it thanks to refreshing combat mechanics and ridiculously frantic boss fights." [/i]
~ [b]PC Invasion, 8/10[/b]

[i]"Eldest Souls is a solid contender for our favourite Souls-like of the year" [/i]
~ [b]Gamereactor, 8/10[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36102687/af16eb1c847e3c17bff693b62ea977425f57ce0c.png[/img]

[h3]Eldest Souls Feature:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Battle your way through a series of uniquely challenging Boss-Rush combat encounters.
[*] Discover a cast of intriguing NPCs and questlines as you explore the ancient Citadel.
[*] Unearth the mystery of the Old Gods, before total devastation befalls the World.
[*] Bask in the glorious pixel-perfect graphic style, dripping in gorgeous attention-to-detail.
[*] Your Build. Your Rules. Customize your own combat style from a multitude of ability combinations.
[/list]

notes.title: New Trailer Confirms Eldest Souls Release Date
notes.notes:
The Old Gods begin to stir...

As announced during the E3 Future Games Show, we’re delighted to confirm that it’s very nearly time to unsheath your swords, lone warriors. 

[b]Eldest Souls will release on the 29th July 2021. [/b]

The news was confirmed in the form of a brand new, fully animated trailer depicting the epic story of the world, from the humble beginnings of man, to their enslavement by the Old Gods, and finally, to mankind’s eventual uprising. Ending on a note of futility, our nameless hero overlooks the collosal Citadel, wherein lies a nigh-impossible task - to overthrow the Old Gods once and for all. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1108590/Eldest_Souls//]Wishlist on Steam now![/url]

[previewyoutube=pycbk5BP1ls;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1108590/Eldest_Souls/

Also announced during E3, United Label will be releasing the Epic Adventure-RPG, [i]Tails of Iron[/i], later this year. With a focus on punishingly brutal, soulslike inspired combat, this deceivingly-beautiful, hand-drawn title is fully narrated by the deep, raspy vocals of Doug Cockle. As Redgi, heir to the Rat Throne, you must restore your broken Kingdom by banishing the merciless Frog Clan and their ferocious leader, Greenwart. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36102687/9e9a265789dc2ead42bee15a0172a1548cdaf6fb.png[/img]

From frog zombies to gargantuan grubs - and everything in-between - the Kingdom is awash with danger. To overcome each perilous encounter, players will need to study their opponent’s attacks and react accordingly! Thankfully, there’s a range of deadly abilities on offer, including parry bashes and fatal executions, not to mention ranged attacks with your nifty bow and arrow.  Watch the epic new trailer below, and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1283410/Tails_of_Iron/]wishlist on Steam now[/url]!
